disposition_reason: Optode and ICP-AES germanium means (n = 6 replicate readings) for ten purchased foods from Benha City, Egypt (11.2 to 71.3 ng/g), plus water and soil values with ambiguous units.
disposition_locator: Table 4, p. 2811; Table 3, p. 2810; Methods p. 2805

study.design: analytical method development with application to purchased foods, water and soil
study.method: Colorimetric optode (DMTMP and Aliquat-336 in TEHP-plasticized cellulose triacetate), absorbance at 545 nm; reflux HNO3:H2SO4 (10:1) plus H2O2 digestion of 5.00 g food; ICP-AES comparison
lod: LOD 1.75 ng/mL and LOQ 5.75 ng/mL germanium(IV) in solution (p. 2801, p. 2807)
study.qa: Spike recovery and comparison with ICP-AES by t and F tests; no certified reference material reported

findings.group: Bean purchased from supermarkets in Benha City, Egypt; unspiked; number of samples not stated
findings.notes: Mean ± SD of n = 6 determinations (number of purchased samples not stated); ng/g equals µg/kg. Basis (fresh or dry) not stated. Text on p. 2811 names AAS as the reference method while Table 4 labels the comparison column ICP-AES.
